title: 英伟达董事会先拒后迎：黄仁勋回归，谁在改写结局？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Pierre, you've been watching these headlines just as much as we have.
segments.zh: 皮埃尔，你一直和我们一样关注这些头条。

segments.en: What do you make of it? Well, first I'm very happy.
segments.zh: 你怎么看？首先，我非常高兴。

segments.en: It's something we've been really fighting for, and mobilizing the whole community for that.
segments.zh: 这是我们一直努力争取的事情，并且动员了整个社区。

segments.en: Remember, we had a petition sign by 25% of NVIDIA employees
segments.zh: 记住，我们有25%的英伟达员工签署了请愿书，

segments.en: by a lot of leading names on Wall Street and in the Silicon Valley.
segments.zh: 还有许多华尔街和硅谷的知名人士。

segments.en: It's great to see that this influence works like, you know, influenced the way the government, the way the board looked at the situation.
segments.zh: 很高兴看到这种影响力发挥了作用，影响了政府和董事会看待局势的方式。

segments.en: And to me, the bottom line is there might have been things that require, you know, some adjustments, some wrong doings,
segments.zh: 对我来说，底线是可能有些事情需要一些调整，一些不当行为，

segments.en: of course, but you don't want to take decisions too quick.
segments.zh: 当然，但你不希望决策太快。

segments.en: And most importantly, when you need to discipline a CEO, that's an important thing to do, but you don't want to discipline shareholders at the same time.
segments.zh: 最重要的是，当你需要约束CEO时，这很重要，但你不希望同时约束股东。

segments.en: And here, it became more and more apparent that NVIDIA, without Jensen, was actually not going to be able to do as well.
segments.zh: 在这里，越来越明显的是，没有Jensen的英伟达实际上无法表现得那么好。

segments.en: And of course, that could have been like a punishment for shareholders that I thought was not a good idea.
segments.zh: 当然，那可能对股东来说是一种惩罚，我认为那不是个好主意。

segments.en: So it's great to see the board work on what happened, investigate what happened, and move forward.
segments.zh: 所以很高兴看到董事会就所发生的事展开工作、进行调查并向前推进。

segments.en: But Pierre, don't you say that NVIDIA, at least the board, is now less credible because they walk back on their own word.
segments.zh: 但皮埃尔，你不是说英伟达，至少董事会，现在因为食言而信誉受损吗？
